headline: O'Hare is running behind while a delay program slows Seattle arrivals.

items.text: Chicago O'Hare is at 80% on time (within 30 minutes of schedule) so far today, with 460 departed, behind the other hubs, which are at 89% or better.

No FAA ground stop or ground delay program is in effect at any United hub, and weather is not affecting operations at any of the 9 United hubs with a current report. A ground delay program for flights into Seattle runs until 9:59 PM PT, with delays averaging 32 minutes, up to 82 minutes.
The FAA's plan lists possible programs for flights into Newark tomorrow after 10:00 AM ET and into San Francisco tomorrow after 7:00 AM PT; neither is in effect.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to Seattle, check your flight status before leaving for the airport.
